text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"Run, run... RUN!! 
HAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA!!!!!"

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: ...This pressure...!!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"A full comeback", huh, Craft! That's the 
spirit! —Haaaaaa...!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Waaaah...!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
"Woooow...!" "This generation really is 
insane!" "Craft was amazing too...!!" 
"Craft, show us another awesome run!"

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much for your support, 
everyone! Please come watch the races 
again soon~!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
...To think she's conditioned herself this 
much. Far from having no issues left— 
hasn't she powered up even more?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Yes, truly...

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
"Great job out there, Messiah-san!" 
"Heart-chan, you were super cool today 
too~~!" "Everyone was amazing!!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: ！ Thank you!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Yes—aren't we just the absolute best!?

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
"...No seriously... this generation is 
crazy good, isn't it? Even the girls on 
the Tiara path—"

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
That girl on the Classic Triple Crown 
route just racked up another win the other 
day, too... Wait, does that mean this 
generation is absolutely on fire!?

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Btw Heart-chan, she's so poised and 
amazing. Maybe that passion... is being 
led by her.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Heart-san...

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
...Hehe. Perfect... More... Give me 
more...!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Hey... Craft, Messiah!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
The dazzling brilliance of the Tiara that 
enchanted our past selves... With who we 
are now—

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Don't you think I can show you a light 
that surpasses the past—a far more 
brilliant light?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... Yeah! If it's us, we can do it, we 
can leave our mark—

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Let us show our greatest radiance! The 
spring pinnacle for Senior-tier Tiara 
Umamusume—

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"At the Victoria Mile! ――Let's run our 
absolute best race yet!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: ! The best one yet...—

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
(A battle that surpasses that Oka Sho... 
The climax of our youth— at the Victoria 
Mile...!)

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
...I accept your challenge. —To connect it 
to the next shining moment.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
It's settled! Let's show them our best 
race— at the Victoria Mile!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
—And so, I just went with the flow and 
made the decision, but...

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Our next target is the Victoria Mile... 
That sounds good to you, right? ...Right?
choice_data_list: Yeah, it's not a problem at all.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Victoria Mile is one of the biggest 
Senior-class GⅠs on the Tiara route... I 
was actually planning to suggest it 
myself.
choice_data_list:
Looks like this is gonna be another 
incredible race...!

Looks like this is going to be another 
incredible race...!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Messiah's strength is rock-solid, and 
Craft... she's completely back to being 
the 'genius girl' she was.
choice_data_list:
Genius prodigy... Yeah, they definitely 
call you that.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Still, does that really capture the full 
extent of her strength...?!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Because it's like she has no limits at 
all! Every time I face her, she's faster 
than before—she's constantly growing, 
isn't she?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"That's why every time, I want to surpass 
it... and my chest burns with passion."

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
My heart trembles at the thought of 
clashing with them!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
...There were nights I wondered if 
choosing the 'NHK Mile Cup' was the right 
call, but...

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"I'm really glad I kept chasing after it. 
Because of that, I can enjoy racing this 
much..."
choice_data_list:
And the ultimate climax... lies just 
ahead.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"That's right! In the Victoria Mile, we'll 
engrave our present――our passion!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Tact! Sorry for keeping you waiting!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
No, I'm fine. I was just taking a look 
around the racetrack...

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
...Wherever I went, everyone was talking 
non-stop about Heart and the others.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
My heart was deeply moved as well... The 
radiant youth of everyone competing with 
all their might was simply dazzling...

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
And in my eyes, Heart-san— among all that 
colorful brilliance, you shone the 
brightest of all.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Yes. No matter the situation... Heart-san 
was always running with an excited look on 
her face...

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"...It was beautiful. That strength of 
heart to truly enjoy the competition—"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Tact...

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
...I want to run with strong conviction, 
too. —Just like Heart-san.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
...I accept your challenge. —To connect it 
to the next shining moment.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: (...Ah. So that's what it was...—)

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: ...Hehe. What a cute sleeping face.
choice_data_list:
You must be tired too, feel free to get 
some sleep.

You must be tired too, feel free to get 
some sleep

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Hey, I've... gotten so much stronger, 
haven't I?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Just as Tact said, being able to enjoy the 
race is because... I gained the toughness 
to persevere no matter the development.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
That is—proof that the weapon known as my 
heart is being honed to perfection...

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
...Passing that on to this child 
someday... might be nice too.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
What's the rush? Everyone grows up 
eventually, don't they?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Still, don't worry. That won't be anytime 
soon... I'm going to live my youth to the 
absolute fullest first!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: First—at the Victoria Mile!
